# Patient RX System v2.0.65

## Production Rollup: v2.0.60 through v2.0.65

This release includes every production change from `v2.0.60` through `v2.0.65`. It promotes the tested staging work into production, adds dashboard analytics and graphing improvements, fixes production graph schema readiness, and improves list/report performance with database-level pagination.

## Included Releases

### v2.0.65 - Dashboard analytics and pagination performance

- Promotes the tested staging dashboard analytics work into production.
- Moves RX Records list display to database-level pagination so only the visible page is loaded.
- Keeps legacy `/api/rx-records` full-array behavior for existing callers while the RX Records screen uses `paginated=true`.
- Loads the RX Records patient selector in the background so the full patient picker no longer blocks the RX table.
- Adds RX Records workflow-stage filtering.
- Moves Patient Report and RX Action Report screen display to database-level pagination.
- Keeps report CSV/Excel export as full filtered export, fetched only when the export action is used.
- Defaults Patient Management, RX Records, Patient Report, and RX Action Report to 10 rows per page.

### v2.0.64 - Production dashboard trend schema fallback

- Expands the dashboard trend schema guard so production waits for the full `DailySnapshots` trend column set before querying graphs.
- Prevents `/api/dashboard/charts` from throwing when older production databases are missing `patientsWithNoRx` or related trend columns.
- Keeps graph behavior stable while production databases finish migration/startup verification.

### v2.0.63 - Production graph fallback stabilization

- Adds a visible blank-state fallback when dashboard trend panels have no usable graph payload.
- Prevents dashboard trend cards from staying blank when graph data is empty or not yet available.
- Improves production graph messaging during migration or data-readiness gaps.

### v2.0.62 - Production graphing schema guard

- Adds a production-safe snapshot schema check so dashboard trend graphing waits until the new `DailySnapshots` trend columns exist.
- Prevents daily snapshot capture from running against an older production schema before migration is applied.
- Adds dashboard messaging so graphing shows as migration-pending instead of failing silently.

### v2.0.61 - Dashboard trends, analytics pagination, and production report prep

- Adds dashboard trend history metrics to `DailySnapshots`, including patient eligibility, no-RX, service-date window, workflow, and activity counters.
- Adds dashboard trend graph cards for patients, RX/workflow, eligibility, and workflow completion.
- Adds shared dashboard graph range controls and CSV export support.
- Keeps Login Activity metrics in the snapshot/backoffice layer while removing the Login Activity card from the main dashboard.
- Fixes dashboard trend date handling so date-only snapshot values stay on the intended local calendar day.
- Adds server-side Backoffice Analytics pagination so large snapshot histories no longer delay the table display.
- Fixes Patient Report and RX Action Report row selectors so 10, 20, 50, and 100 display only the selected page size.
- Defaults Patient Management filtering toward active patients so dashboard card drilldowns and list totals match unless inactive records are explicitly requested.
- Preserves staging/development bulk-data tooling for QA speed and functionality tests. Production does not use the bulk seed path.

### v2.0.60 - Dashboard drilldowns and patient filter refinement

- Fixes the Dashboard Pending Deliveries full-page link so it opens RX Records with the pending workflow filter applied.
- Adds RX Records Workflow Status filtering and sorting for Pending, Not Started, In Progress, and Completed workflow states.
- Adds Patient Management filters for missing clinic, default pharmacy, patient transport, and pharmacy transport information.
- Adds cascading Patient Management relationship filters so Clinic, Default Pharmacy, Patient Transport, and Pharmacy Transport options narrow to related patients.
- Fixes Dashboard RX drilldown workflow progress bars so partial workflows no longer render as fully complete.

## Performance Results From Staging

- RX Records page display improved from about `800-850 ms` to about `30-55 ms`.
- RX Records workflow-stage filter tested at about `26 ms`.
- RX Records patient-name filter tested at about `35 ms`.
- Patient Report display improved from about `1.2 sec` full load to about `28 ms` page load.
- RX Action Report display improved from about `9.8 sec` full load to about `28 ms` page load.
- RX Action Report pending filter tested at about `20 ms`.

## Database Impact

- Run the normal production migration/startup path so the `DailySnapshots` trend columns are present.
- Required dashboard trend migration: `20260628103000-add-dashboard-trend-metrics-to-daily-snapshots.js`.
- No destructive schema or data changes are included.
- Existing patients, RX records, service-date cycles, workflow history, reports data, and audit records are preserved.
- Existing performance indexes cover the promoted paginated patient/RX/report query paths.
- Future optional tuning: if production text searches become slow at much larger data volume, add stronger functional or trigram indexes for name/search fields.

## Validation Completed

- JavaScript syntax checks passed for modified controllers and browser scripts.
- RX Records, Dashboard, and Reports inline EJS script validation passed.
- `npm run db:migrate` completed with schema already up to date in the checked environment.
- Local production/main smoke test passed on `localhost:3000`.
- `/api/version` reported `2.0.65`.
- RX Records pagination, RX workflow-stage filtering, Patient Report pagination, RX Action Report pagination, and Dashboard charts API all responded successfully.
- Compiled `dist/server.exe` verified with `dist/server.exe --v`.

## Production Verification Checklist

After installing the `v2.0.65` update:

1. Confirm the sidebar/version badge shows `v2.0.65`.
2. Confirm Dashboard graphs load and do not stay blank.
3. Confirm Dashboard card links open the expected filtered patient or RX list.
4. Confirm Patients defaults to 10 rows and filters still work.
5. Confirm RX Records defaults to 10 rows, filters work, and workflow-stage filtering works.
6. Confirm Patient Report and RX Action Report open quickly with 10-row pages.
7. Confirm CSV/Excel exports still export the full filtered result.
